questions.chapter: Project Management Fundamentals & Project Life Cycle
questions.text: Define a Project. Explain the Project Life Cycle phases (Inception, Planning/Design, Execution/Construction, Commissioning, and Handover). Explain the Project Management Iron Triangle (Scope, Time, Cost, and Quality).

Compare Critical Path Method (CPM - Deterministic) vs. Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT - Probabilistic). For a given construction project with 8 activities, draw the AON (Activity on Node) / AOA network diagram, calculate Earliest Start (ES), Earliest Finish (EF), Latest Start (LS), Latest Finish (LF), Total Float ($TF = LS - ES$), Free Float ($FF$), and Independent Float ($IF$). Identify the Critical Path.

In a PERT network, the three time estimates (Optimistic $t_o$, Most Likely $t_m$, and Pessimistic $t_p$) for activities are given. Calculate the Expected Activity Duration ($t_e = \frac{t_o + 4t_m + t_p}{6}$) and Variance ($\sigma^2 = \left(\frac{t_p - t_o}{6}\right)^2$). Calculate project expected completion duration $T_e$, standard deviation $\sigma_{cp}$, and the probability of completing the project 3 weeks ahead of scheduled target date $T_s$ using the standard normal distribution table ($Z = \frac{T_s - T_e}{\sigma_{cp}}$).

Explain Time-Cost Trade-Off (Project Crashing). Define Normal Time ($T_n$), Normal Cost ($C_n$), Crash Time ($T_c$), Crash Cost ($C_c$), and Cost Slope ($S = \frac{C_c - C_n}{T_n - T_c}$). Crash a given project network step-by-step to find the Optimum Project Duration and Minimum Total Project Cost considering direct and indirect costs per day.

Explain the selection, output calculations, and economic operation of heavy construction equipment: (a) Earthmoving equipment (Excavators, Bulldozers, Scrapers, Motor Graders), (b) Hauling equipment (Dumpers, Trucks), (c) Compaction equipment (Rollers), and (d) Concrete batching and placing equipment (Transit mixers, Concrete pumps).

questions.chapter: Quality Control, Contract Administration & Dispute Resolution
questions.text: Explain Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) in construction projects. Explain Earned Value Management (EVM) parameters: Planned Value ($PV$), Earned Value ($EV$), Actual Cost ($AC$), Schedule Variance ($SV = EV - PV$), Cost Variance ($CV = EV - AC$), Schedule Performance Index ($SPI = EV / PV$), and Cost Performance Index ($CPI = EV / AC$).

questions.chapter: Quality Control, Contract Administration & Dispute Resolution
questions.text: Explain Dispute Resolution mechanisms in construction contracts according to FIDIC / PPMO: (a) Negotiation, (b) Dispute Adjudication Board (DAB) / Dispute Resolution Board (DRB), (c) Mediation / Conciliation, and (d) Arbitration (UNCITRAL / Nepal Arbitration Act).
Compare Resource Smoothing vs. Resource Leveling in construction project management. Draw resource load histograms.
